message:
Now I see it. In `ReadHeader50` (RAR 5 format), `PackSize` and `UnpSize` are read as unsigned values:

```cpp
hd->PackSize=UINT32TO64(HighPackSize,hd->DataSize);
hd->UnpSize=UINT32TO64(HighUnpSize,LowUnpSize);
```

These are unsigned. So `PackSize` can't be negative in RAR 5 format. The negative `PackSize` issue must be in RAR 4.x format (ReadHeader15). Let me check that:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -n "ReadHeader15" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/unrar/arcread.cpp | head -5</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
